task: Search for a park in the state of California called Castle Mountains National Monument and find out it's Basic Information.
answer:
FINAL: Castle Mountains National Monument is in California. Its official National Park Service Basic Information page lists:

• Hours: Open 24 hours every day, year-round.
• Admission: Free year-round; no entrance fee or pass required.
• Address listed: 2701 Barstow Road, Barstow, CA 92311.
• Access: Walking Box Ranch Road from Nevada State Route 164 (Nipton Road), or unnamed dirt roads from Lanfair Road in Mojave National Preserve.
• Facilities: None within the monument. Visitor centers in neighboring Mojave National Preserve provide information and orientation.
• Weather: Freezing winter temperatures with occasional snow; mild spring; summer temperatures near 100°F; late-summer storms can cause flash floods and hazardous roads; cooler fall.
• Connectivity: No public Wi-Fi; cellular reception can be spotty.
• Phone: (760) 252-6100.

Evidence: Official NPS “Basic Information,” https://www.nps.gov/camo/planyourvisit/basicinfo.htm (accessed October 27, 2026; page displays “Last updated: March 3, 2016”). The monument was located through Google Maps at https://www.google.com/maps/place/Castle+Mountains+National+Monument/@35.3017648,-115.1292349,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x80cf0626a3802351:0x7b5a007ac656513b!8m2!3d35.3017604!4d-115.12666!16s%2Fg%2F11c5_zm9jq?hl=en .
